# Map, inspector, pause and navigation

Inspect, pause, and begin another run without accidentally advancing the economy\.

Start from the main menu, choose New Run or unlimited Sandbox, then review the challenge, charter, Expanding Economy v3 map preview, and Ascension 0 or 1\. Setup, seed editing and reference browsing do not advance economic time or reroll a started world\.

The left rail opens Map, Harbor, Industry, Fleet, Economy and Goals\. Select a town or ship on the chart to reveal its right inspector; Clear selection restores the unselected map\. The bottom activity strip links actual food, fleet and objective facts to their relevant views\. Harbor has three paired trading workflows; Industry separates factories from warehouse rules; Fleet opens the selected owned ship's route planner\. Economy and Goals retain the detailed accounts and Journal\.

Switching modes and opening management views pauses playback\. Inspection, route overlays and Back never trade, move stock, advance a day or enable automation\. Harbor, Industry and planner return to their previous context with the relevant town and ship retained\. Use Play or Next day deliberately; the pause menu's explicit Resume restores playback only if it was running when pause opened\.

Escape handles the active confirmation or reserve/inline editor before its parent view, then returns Harbor, Industry and detailed screens to their context\. Fleet, Economy and town choosers return to Map; ordinary Map opens pause\. View log in the activity strip opens the full operational inspector, activity and run identity\. Company remains reachable through pause or Fleet's Company / shipwright action\.

Restart, abandonment, return to menu, and exit protect unsaved active progress with confirmation\. Exit closes the standalone game\. Save explicitly before leaving; Continue or Load restores a valid local saved run, while Retry Same World creates its initial state again\.

The encyclopedia is available from the main menu, run setup, and pause menu\. Browse a category, search names or descriptions, follow related entries, and use Back to return\. All recipe facts are generated from the same content the simulation loads and work offline\. Settings offers four game\-wide text sizes without changing the world\.

New Run defaults to Expanding Economy v3 and the Grand Commission; Sandbox is the unlimited alternative\. Inspect the large interactive map before drafting\. Invalid seed text leaves the last valid preview intact\. Retry and Load preserve the original run identity; retired world modes are not menu choices\.
